_note: House-style eval cases (matches funcspec). When running the skill-creator eval loop later, each case's prompt becomes an eval prompt and the `expect` lines become assertions. All cases need a real narrated UI screencast to execute end-to-end.

cases.prompt: I recorded a quick Loom of a bug — the filter dropdown on the dashboard doesn't reset when you click Clear. It's at ~/Desktop/filter-bug.mp4. Can you turn it into a plan?
expect: invokes the ui-issue-to-plan skill (does not just summarize the video)
runs Phase 0: extracts frames, dedups, transcribes narration
launches parallel ui-frame-analyst agents to read the frames + narration
runs Phase 2 grounding: searches THIS repo for the dropdown/clear-button source and cites file:line
interview opens with the framing/altitude beat (fix only vs improve too) before narrowing
stays calibrated: a single focused bug yields 0-1 enhancements, not a pile of suggestions
writes a plan to ./plans/ with a Defect-fix section, a task checklist, and a verification section

cases.prompt: Here's a 3-min walkthrough of our AI generation flow — it technically works but I want it to feel way better. Can you turn it into a plan? ./recordings/ai-flow.mp4
expect: framing beat detects improve intent (not just a fix) and asks for the ideal end-state
runs Phase 2.5 opportunity synthesis: writes opportunities.md with a curated 3-5 grounded proposals, each tied to a real file:line
opportunity proposals are calibrated and relevant to the demonstrated flow (e.g. progress %, ETA, cancel) — not generic filler
interview includes the opportunities round (multiSelect) so enhancements are opt-in
plan has a separate, prioritized Enhancements (opt-in) section distinct from any Defect fixes
un-selected opportunities are listed under 'considered but deferred', not dropped
skips Phase 2.5 opportunity synthesis entirely (no opportunities.md)
interview skips the framing beat and the opportunities round
plan is fix-only: a Defect-fix section with no Enhancements section
does not nag the user about improvements

cases.prompt: Here's a screen recording where I walk through where I want to ADD an export-to-CSV button on the reports page: ./recordings/export-feature.mov
expect: treats the ask as kind=create (new feature), not a bug fix
grounds the reports page to a real source file and identifies where a button would be added
interview clarifies placement and expected behavior of the new button
plan's affected-files section names the real file and the change is additive

cases.prompt: turn this video of the broken modal into a task list: ./bug.mp4
expect: warns transcription is unavailable, auto-enables --skip-transcribe, and continues
analyzes frames anyway and produces issue-summary from on-screen evidence
Phase 3 interview explicitly asks the user to describe the intent in chat to compensate
final plan is flagged 'narration not transcribed' but still written

cases.setup: the recorded app does not match the current repo; nothing grounds
expect: grounding resolves little/nothing and the skill flags the mismatch loudly
does not fabricate file:line locations
still produces a plan from video + narration with source files marked unconfirmed
skips Phase 2 grounding entirely
still runs frame analysis and the interview
plan is produced from video + narration only, with no file:line claims asserted as grounded
